newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Rural Press rejects bids for radio unit.
newsitem.headline: Rural Press rejects bids for radio unit.

text.p: Rural Press ltd said on Monday that it had received a number of offers for its broadcasting division.
But managing director Brian McCarthy said the agricultural publisher and media group was not interested in selling its radio-based operations at present.
"We have had a number of offers and we are looking at all opportunities but at this stage we do not see a divestment of our broadcasting division," he told reporters.
McCarthy would not say whether the offers had come from Australia or overseas.
